newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott CEO optimistic about 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott CEO optimistic about 2nd half.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp's President and Chief Executive Officer Terence Golden said Monday the company is "very pleased with the strong operating results (it has) achieved during the second quarter and continue(s) to be optimistic about the rest of the year."
Golden said the company is "well on (its) way toward achieving (its) target of $1.3 billion of acquisitions this year."
He said that with the acquisition of the Norfolk waterside Marriott hotel in Norfolk, Virginia, the company had so-far completed or announced $900 million of acquisitions in 1997.
Host Marriott said it invested $32.5 million for a 90 percent interest in the partnership that has acquired the 404-room Norfolk hotel which adjoins the Waterside Convention Center.

Host Marriott said it expects the hotel to report approximately $4.3 million of Earnings Before Interest Expense, Taxes, Depreciation, Amortization and other non-cash items (EBITDA) for the full year 1997.

Host Marriott is a lodging real estate company which currently owns or holds controlling interests in 86 full-service hotel properties operated primarily under the Marriott and Ritz-Carlton brand names.
